notes.title: Whimsical Wizardry Patch Notes - Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed crash relating to the object pooling system
-Rockslide spell now functions as intended
-Added more songs to the soundtrack, now each stage has its own song
-Fixed ghost animation in the graveyard so it no longer t-poses
-Main menu music now properly loops
-Renamed It's-A-Me achievement to Calista's Challenge in memory of the woman who suggested the achievement

notes.title: Whimsical Wizardry Patch Notes - Version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
-Added random map and game mode selection
-Replaced temporary art in load screens
-Adjusted number of players required for the hill in King of the Hill to move (3 for 4+ players, 2 for 3- players)
-Fixed networking issue on Hot Potato explosion
-Fixed the achievement "We Can't Name this Achievement What We Want To" not being awarded
-Adjusted volume of spell sound effects
